title: C2MS L1 학습의 높은 학습률 단계 감소와 학습 연장
hypothesis: QB models above C2MS (S2WMamba 0.63M, LFormer 0.59M, U2Net+PAKAN, CANNet, LAGNet+ADWM) are 3-5x smaller but all train with L1 at a peak learning rate of 3e-4 to 2e-3 for 200-800 epochs, while every full C2MS training so far used 1e-4 -> 1e-6 cosine for 150 or 300 epochs. If C2MS is held back by its schedule rather than by its capacity, a higher step-decayed rate with a longer L1 training raises RR PSNR and lowers SAM with the architecture unchanged.

evidence.experiment_63: L1 instead of MSE at the same 150-epoch 1e-4 cosine schedule: QB seed 42 RR +0.084 dB, SAM -0.060 deg against 53
evidence.experiment_59: MSE, 300-epoch 1e-4 cosine: GF2 +0.205 dB, WV3 +0.366 dB, QB test -0.284 dB with QB validation +0.096 dB
evidence.experiment_72: the C2MS gain sits at periods under 8 px; no learning rate above 1e-4 was ever used for the whole C2MS network (61/62 trained only small heads at 1e-3)
evidence.literature: S2WMamba 360 epochs, AdamW 4e-4 x0.7 every 100 epochs, L1; U2Net+PAKAN 500 epochs, Adam 4e-4 x0.7 every 100 epochs, L1; CANNet QB 200 epochs, 5e-4 constant, L1; LFormer 800 epochs, 3e-4 x0.1 at 300 and 500, L1 + 0.1 SSIM. Paper-reported settings, not reproduced here.

arms.C2MS_L1S: unchanged C2MS architecture (SSA-MRN K4 + W2), fresh training, L1 on the original and the 2x coarser pairs, Adam lr 4e-4 multiplied by 0.7 after epochs 100, 200 and 300, 360 epochs
arms.C2MS_L1C: the same with lr 1e-4 -> 1e-6 cosine over 360 epochs; separates the learning-rate schedule from the training length

comparisons.official: each arm against the archived 53 C2MS of the same seed (v2.3)
comparisons.learning_rate: C2MS_L1S against C2MS_L1C (same loss, same length)
comparisons.length: C2MS_L1C against the archived 63 C2MS_L1 (same loss and rate, 150 epochs)

loss: original per-pixel L1 + 1.0 x per-pixel L1 on the 2x coarser pairs, as experiment 63
precision: FP16 AMP core training with GradScaler; FP32 transforms, loss, validation and evaluation (as 53/63)
selection: minimum original-scale validation MSE including epoch 0, earliest exact tie; test never used for selection (same rule as 53/63)
control_policy: No new control run, as 63: the archived 53 C2MS of the same seed is the official control and the 57 retrained C2MS is reported as a second reference for RR2 and the observation ratio, which vary between runs.
expected_duration: about 7 h per arm on the RTX 3060 Ti (53 needed about 3 h for 150 epochs)
stability_check: C2MS_L1S is checked after epoch 3 inside the trainer (train.stability): all losses finite, skipped AMP updates <= 1 % of attempted, epoch-3 training loss below epoch 1. If any fails, the run stops and the rate is not changed without user approval.

judgement.criteria: docs/judgement_criteria.md v2.3 against the same-seed 53 C2MS; single seed noise threshold 0.06 dB
judgement.reported: validation PSNR/SAM per epoch, RR/RR2/FR_WALD/FR observation, FR QNR/D_lambda/D_s as reference only, the frequency split of experiment 72 for the chosen arm

stages.1_gate: an arm passes v2.3 against 53 with RR PSNR >= +0.06 dB and its validation PSNR also above 53 (experiment 59 showed QB validation and test can disagree)
stages.2: GF2 and WV3 seed 42 of the passing arm, WV2 transfer reported, after user approval
stages.3: seeds 43 and 44 on the sensors that pass, paired 3-seed v2.3 against 53/54; a baseline change needs the 3-seed improvement

limits: the literature settings were tuned for smaller models; a 2.85M network may train differently at the same rate
runtime_note: The 2026-10-27 shared cache C:/CtrS-p59 was gone on 2026-11-03 (server reorganized, data re-copied to C:/CtrS/PAN-MS). Caches are rebuilt from the H5 into the runtime and checked against the hashes recorded by experiment 63.
